chunks: And in the narration of ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥajjāj, from him, peace be upon him:
That he prayed two rakʿahs and entered iḥrām at Masjid al-Shajarah. Then he went out, and khabīṣ containing saffron was brought to him, and he ate from it before reciting the talbiyah.

key_terms.مَسْجِدِ ٱلشَّجَرَةِ: Masjid al-Shajarah, the miqat location mentioned here
key_terms.يُلَبِّيَ: to recite the talbiyah of iḥrām

ai.seo_question: Can a person eat saffron-containing food before reciting the talbiyah after entering iḥrām?
ai.summary: This narration describes that the Imam عليه السلام prayed two rakʿahs and entered iḥrām at Masjid al-Shajarah, then ate a saffron-containing sweet dish before reciting the talbiyah. It is relevant to the jurisprudence of hajj and the sequence of acts connected to entering iḥrām.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2567 - In a narration from Abdul Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, from Imam (as):
He prayed two units of prayer and entered Ihram at Masjid al-Shajarah. Then he went out and was brought a dessert containing saffron, and he ate from it before reciting the Talbiyah.
